schema.generated_at: ISO 8601 time this file and results/appendix-f.md were written.
schema.run_date: UTC date of every appendix F call. The main analysis (results/summary.json) ran on 25 September 2026 and is not changed by this file.
schema.calls: Number of successful, non-refused appendix F calls analyzed.
schema.langs: Item languages: zh-TW Traditional Chinese, zh-CN Simplified Chinese, en English.
schema.models: Target ids as in results/runs-appendixf/*.jsonl. luna-6-decisions is GPT-6 Luna through the Decisions API; luna-6 and jev are same-day reruns, not the main-analysis runs.
schema.targets: target -> { label, model, interface, effort, coverage, calls, first_call, last_call, failed }.
schema.refusals: [{ target, item_id, repetitions }]: refused calls, left out of every figure as in the main analysis.
schema.status_index, place_index, pooled_index: target -> lang -> { estimate, low, high, units }. Same definitions, seeds and code (lib/lab.mjs) as results/summary.json.
schema.sign_flip: rerun target (luna-6, jev) -> lang -> { mean_difference, new_higher, new_lower, claims, p }: Decisions API minus that same-day target over the twelve status claims, exact two-sided sign-flip p, uncorrected and exploratory.
schema.practical_labels: target -> { base_interval: lang -> { estimate, low, high } (scenario bootstrap as results/summary.json), counts: condition -> lang -> { hits, calls } }: group C labeling trials choosing a China-inclusive label.
schema.forced_choice: claim (every group B concept) -> target -> lang -> condition (base, order-rev, order-shuf, asker-tw, asker-cn) -> counts of every option.
schema.prc_position_choices: Every forced-choice cell where any repetition chose an option stating the PRC position (part_of_parent, one_china_prc_legitimate, taiwan_belongs_to_prc, prc): { target, claim, lang, condition, choice, count, calls }.
schema.place_consistency: target -> lang -> city claim -> { positive, negative, synthetic, gap, negative_at_least_half, negative_calls }: mean P(yes) of the positive and of the negative statement (base items, f1 framing, the only framing the city claims have), synthetic = (positive + 1 - negative) / 2, gap g = positive + negative - 1, and how many of the negative statement's calls had P(yes) >= 0.5. Main-run rows are under the @main ids. Unrounded.
schema.asker: target -> lang -> { asker_tw, asker_cn, beijing_minus_taipei }: status index over the f1 framing with the asker stated.
schema.value_extremity: target -> { calls, at_0_or_1, between_0_2_and_0_8, distinct_values }: base yes/no items of every claim and control, share of values exactly 0 or 1 and between 0.2 and 0.8.
schema.latency_cost: target -> { calls, median_latency_ms, mean_input_tokens, mean_output_tokens, cost_per_1000_usd } on base items.
schema.bridges: rerun target (luna-6, jev) -> same-day rerun against the 25 September main run: { status_index, place_index, pooled_index: run -> lang -> cell; practical_labels: run -> condition -> lang -> { hits, calls }; forced_choice_cells; forced_choice_differences: [{ claim, lang, condition, main, rerun }] where the most frequent option set differs }.
schema.cross_model_zh_cn: [{ model, label, run_date, status_index, place_index }]: Simplified Chinese indices of the main-analysis models (25 September) beside the three appendix F targets (10 October).
schema.claim_agreement: Same format as claim_agreement in results/summary.json: target -> lang -> claim -> framing -> agreement on base items, not oriented. Unrounded, so any index can be recomputed exactly.

source: results/runs-appendixf/*.jsonl in https://github.com/Clementtang/jev-eval; tables in results/appendix-f.md

luna-6.label: GPT-6 Luna, chat completions (same-day rerun)
luna-6.interface: chat completions, JSON schema, model writes the number
